title: 执行计划代价估算器：两版 SQL 的代价差
code:
W_SCAN, W_FILTER, W_JOIN, W_SHUFFLE, W_AGG = 1, 1, 10, 6, 2

O_ROWS, U_ROWS = 1000000000, 100000
JOIN_SEL, SEL_DT, SEL_CITY = 1e-9, 0.001, 0.02


def v1_cost():
    """V1：WHERE 写在 JOIN 之后（无法下推）。"""
    c = W_SCAN * O_ROWS + W_SCAN * U_ROWS
    join_out = int(O_ROWS * U_ROWS * JOIN_SEL)
    c += (W_JOIN + W_SHUFFLE) * (O_ROWS + U_ROWS)
    after_dt = int(join_out * SEL_DT)
    c += W_FILTER * join_out
    after_city = int(after_dt * SEL_CITY)
    c += W_FILTER * after_dt
    c += W_AGG * after_city
    return c, O_ROWS + U_ROWS, join_out, after_city


def v2_cost():
    """V2：谓词下推到 Scan（分区裁剪 + 列式过滤）。"""
    o2 = int(O_ROWS * SEL_DT)
    u2 = int(U_ROWS * SEL_CITY)
    c = W_SCAN * o2 + W_SCAN * u2
    join_out = int(o2 * u2 * JOIN_SEL)
    c += (W_JOIN + W_SHUFFLE) * (o2 + u2)
    c += W_AGG * join_out
    return c, o2 + u2, join_out, join_out


print("代价权重: Scan=" + str(W_SCAN) + " Filter=" + str(W_FILTER) +
      " Join=" + str(W_JOIN) + " Shuffle=" + str(W_SHUFFLE) + " Agg=" + str(W_AGG))
print("基数: orders=" + str(O_ROWS) + " users=" + str(U_ROWS) +
      "  选择率: join=" + str(JOIN_SEL) + " dt=" + str(SEL_DT) + " city=" + str(SEL_CITY))
print("")

c1, sh1, jo1, out1 = v1_cost()
c2, sh2, jo2, out2 = v2_cost()

print("V1  SELECT ... FROM (orders JOIN users) t WHERE t.dt=... AND t.city='BJ' ; GROUP BY")
print("  总代价 = " + str(c1))
print("  Shuffle 记录数 = " + str(sh1) + "   Join 输出 = " + str(jo1) + "   最终行数 = " + str(out1))
print("")
print("V2  SELECT ... FROM (orders WHERE dt=...) o JOIN (users WHERE city='BJ') u ; GROUP BY")
print("  总代价 = " + str(c2))
print("  Shuffle 记录数 = " + str(sh2) + "   Join 输出 = " + str(jo2) + "   最终行数 = " + str(out2))
print("")
print("代价差 = " + str(c1 - c2))
print("判据 谓词下推版更优: " + str(c2 < c1))
print("代价下降倍数 = " + str(round(c1 / c2, 2)))
print("判据 Shuffle 记录数下降: " + str(sh2 < sh1) + "   倍数 = " + str(round(sh1 / sh2, 2)))
